title: KPI card
description: A metric card: label, a large tabular figure in the style's figure font, a sub line coloured good / danger. One featured card leads the row; icons are optional and neutral.
when: The metric row at the top of a dashboard (2–4 per row), with the screen's main number as the featured card.
a11y: hint becomes the card's title (tooltip); the figure uses tabular-nums.

examples.title: Dashboard row with a featured figure

instead.need: A colour per card for decoration
instead.use: none: iconTone only when the colour means a status
